The ‘subaccounts’ field is deprecated in v3.

children.title: Overview
children.summary:
A REST API is available for administrators and developers to integrate Vectra’s breach detection data
into their applications.

children.title: Security Detection Data
children.summary:
The "Detections” and “Accounts” elements retrieve security events that can be inserted into external
applications.

children.title: Accessing REST API v3.4
children.summary: The REST API v 3.

children.title: API Clients
children.summary: Getting access to the Vectra Platform API is done through the creation of an API Client.

children.title: Creating a new API Client
children.summary: From the API Clients page, select ‘Add API Client’ to create a new client.

children.title: Authenticating as an API Client
children.summary:
Many REST API tools and libraries can programmatically manage access tokens for you once provided
the OAuth 2.

children.title: Make API request as a client
children.summary:
Now that you have obtained an access_token, you will use that token to make API requests as an API
Client to all the Vectra Platform API endpoints.

children.title: API Rate Limits
children.summary: Rate limits define the frequency of requests that can be made to the v3.

children.title: Detections
children.summary: Detection objects contain all the information related to security events detected in the environment.

children.title: Mark/Unmark Detections as Fixed
children.summary: Marking a detection as Fixed indicates that some remedial action was taken based upon the detection.

children.title: Detection PCAP API
children.summary: Version 3.

children.title: Accounts
children.summary: Account objects contain information related to accounts observed in the environment.

children.title: Tagging
children.summary: The tagging API can be used to manage tags for accounts and detections.

children.title: Triage
children.summary: Version 3 of triage API supports GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE.

children.title: Assignments
children.summary: Assignments are used to assign account objects to analysts for investigation.

children.title: Assignment Resolution
children.summary: Once completed, assignments can be resolved.

children.title: Users
children.summary: User objects contain information about users that have access to the Vectra system.

children.title: Event-based endpoints
children.summary: Event-based endpoints provide a mechanism for API clients to poll Detect for system events.

children.title: Detection Events
children.summary: Detection Events are generated upon initial detection and for each update of the detection.

children.title: Audit Log Events
children.summary: Audit Log Events are generated when a user action is performed on the system.

children.summary: Entities is an overarching term to cover various types of models, including Accounts and Hosts.

children.title: Entity Notes
children.summary: The Entity Notes API can retrieve a list of all notes associated with an entity (Account, Host).

children.title: Groups
children.summary: The groups API can retrieve a listing of groups that are defined on the system.
